scene_preset: Korean folktale illustration, semi-realistic Korean webtoon (manhwa) digital painting, beautiful idealized faces with natural human proportions. The light in the scene MODELS the face: a cast shadow beside the bridge of the nose, volume on the cheekbones, shading under the jaw and lower lip, a readable terminator where the lit side meets the shadow side. Eyes rendered wet and glossy — the iris shows ring texture and radial fibers, the pupil deep, two or three specular catchlights of different sizes on each eyeball, tear-film glint along the lower lash line, individually separated long lashes. A gentle sheen on the glossy black hair where the light falls, darker between the strands, loose stray wisps framing the face. Skin rendered in continuous painterly gradients with subsurface glow and a natural blush on cheeks and nose. Fine thin lineart of varying weight, thicker on the shadow side, thinning to nothing in the light. Clear separation between light and shadow with clean deep darks and rich color, shallow depth of field with the background softly blurred behind the subject. Cinematic widescreen 16:9, highly detailed, high quality. Set in the Joseon dynasty of old Korea; ALL people are Korean wearing traditional hanbok; Korean thatched-roof hanok houses, period-accurate Korean village; NOT Western, NOT European, NOT Japanese, NOT fantasy.
scene_negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark. No glowing white outline around the figure, no halo or aura, no backlit silhouette glow, no over-bright edge lighting, no lens flare or bloom. No flat even lighting, no washed-out low-contrast image, not desaturated, not pastel-faded, not milky, not hazy. Eyes must not be solid black blobs without iris detail. Not flat cel shading with hard two-tone shadow blocks, no thick uniform outlines, no simplified cartoon faces, not chibi, not a 3D CGI render, not a mobile-webtoon-app flat art style.
_comment_scene: 씬 이미지 전용(build.py만 읽음, turnaround/background는 preset 사용). 2026-07-26 _soha_scene_v2로 확정. ★조명 방향·시간대는 여기 넣지 말 것 — chiaroscuro/deep falloff/film-still grading을 넣었더니 모든 씬이 밤으로 끌려갔다(v3/v5 실측). 시간대·광원은 씬별 visual_desc가 정한다. ★후광 금지 문구 필수 — 'silver-white edge tracing the crown'류가 실루엣에 흰 테두리를 둘러 후광처럼 보인다.
